title: Mediterranean Frittata
description: A warm and savory Italian-style omelette filled with Mediterranean flavors, perfect for a satisfying breakfast or brunch.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add sun-dried tomatoes and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Pour the egg mixture over the skillet and cook until the edges start to set.
Sprinkle feta cheese, parsley, and olives over the eggs.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes or until the eggs are set.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
